Bill number: HB2329
<bill_text>
SENATE BILL 2140
 By White

 HOUSE BILL 2329

 By Reneau

 AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 49
 and Title 68, relative to school nurses.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE STATE OF TENNESSEE:

 SECTION 1. Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 49-3-359(c)(2), is amended by

deleting "July 31" and substituting "July 1".

 SECTION 2. This act takes effect upon becoming a law, the public welfare requiring it.
</bill_text>
